top:
Electronic design for agents: board spec, symbols and footprints as TOML

Usage: agentee <COMMAND>

Commands:
  check       Load every board, symbol and footprint under PATH and report problems
  drc         Design rule checks of a layout: its rule diagnostics, or every rule with --list
  list        List the items in a project
  show        Print the resolved model of one item as JSON
  render      Render an item to PNG as the viewer draws it
  view        Open the viewer, it reloads when files change
  mcp         Serve the project over MCP on stdio
  new         Write a starter board, symbol, footprint, schematic, layout or sim
  import      Import from the installed KiCad libraries
  search      Search KiCad library names; every word must match Library:Name
  sim         Run a simulation (*.sim.toml): FDTD, dc, thermal, cascade, channel, pdn or logic
  sparam      Analyse a sim result: TDR, mixed mode, crosstalk, passivity and reciprocity
  models      Download the KiCad 3D models (VRML) the project's footprints name, for the 3D view
  fab         Write the fab package for a layout: Gerbers, drill, BOM, placement, notes
  export      Write the board and every part model of a layout as one STEP assembly, for enclosure CAD
  parts       Stock, price and cheaper equivalents for a layout's or schematic's BOM from Mouser and Farnell, with keys in ~/.config/agentee/distributors.toml
  fill        Fill the zones of a layout and store the copper in its file, so loads skip the fill
  route       Route nets of a layout on a grid and append the tracks and vias to its file
  tie         Tie every SMD pad of a plane net (a net with a zone) to its plane with a stub and a via beside the pad, and append them to the layout file
  tune        Meander the short net of every pair over its skew limit and every match group member short of its target, and write the new points into the tracks
  neck        Neck down track ends that enter a pad narrower than the track or break clearance near it: the end becomes a separate narrower track within the class neckdown length
  place       Place the schematic's parts on the board: connectors on edges, holes and fiducials in corners, large chips central, passives clustered by the netlist, then legalised and refined
  silk        Move every failing silk reference to the clear spot check suggests, again until they settle, and hide the ones with nowhere to go when asked
  testpoints  Add a test pad to each net that has no probe access: a TestPoint part in the schematic, a footprint on the probe side near the net's copper, and a routed track (and via) to it
  calc        Trace calculators
  layout      Run the layout engine on a layout: the configured stages in order, then the score per term
  pinswap     Reassign a chip's swappable I/O (same bank, pairs as pairs, clock pins kept on clock pins) to untangle the ratsnest
  stackups    List the fab stackup presets a board's `stackup.preset` can name, or print one
  edit        Edit a schematic, layout or board with commands instead of writing TOML by hand
  docs        Print the file format reference
  help        Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help     Print help
  -V, --version  Print version

commands.about: Edit a schematic, layout or board with commands instead of writing TOML by hand
commands.help:
Edit a schematic, layout or board with commands instead of writing TOML by hand

Every edit takes the item name and a command. `agentee edit sch help` lists them with their arguments. A list of commands also works: `agentee edit sch -` reads them from stdin, one per line, and `agentee edit sch FILE` from a file, one load, one check at the end. It rewrites the TOML, keeps the comments and layout of the file, and prints the check report of the files it touched.

Pin references are REF.PIN, by number (U1.3) or by a unique pin name (U1.VCC). The pin numbers that came back are in the JSON facts.

Usage: agentee edit [OPTIONS] <TARGET> <NAME> [ARGS]...

Arguments:
  <TARGET>
          schematic, layout or board
          
          [possible values: sch, pcb, board]

  <NAME>
          Item name, `-` for stdin, a script file, or a command

  [ARGS]...
          Arguments of the command

Options:
      --list
          List the item's parts and nets, or its tracks, vias and zones

      --json
          

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')

edits.help:
agentee edit sch ITEM COMMAND [args]   (sch = sch:NAME, pcb = pcb:NAME)
agentee edit sch -   commands on stdin, one per line
agentee edit sch FILE   commands from a file; the project needs exactly one schematic for this

  add REF SYMBOL [VALUE] [--footprint FP] [--at X,Y] [--rotation 90] [--mirror] [--unit 2] [--dnp] [--field key=value]
  remove REF ...  or  remove net NAME ...
  move REF X,Y [--rotation 90] [--mirror] [--unit 2]
  set REF [VALUE] [--value V] [--footprint FP] [--unit 2] [--dnp] [--clear dnp,footprint] [--field k=v]
  net NAME [REF.PIN ...] [--class Power] [--style power|label] [--sheet NAME]
  connect REF.PIN ... NET
  disconnect REF.PIN ...
  nc REF.PIN ...
  unnc REF.PIN ...
  note TEXT ...

agentee edit pcb ITEM COMMAND [args]   (sch = sch:NAME, pcb = pcb:NAME)
agentee edit pcb -   commands on stdin, one per line
agentee edit pcb FILE   commands from a file; the project needs exactly one layout for this

  place REF [X,Y] [--rotation 90] [--bottom] [--locked]
  unplace REF ...
  track NET LAYER X,Y X,Y ... [--width 0.2mm]
  untrack NET | X,Y X,Y ...
  via NET X,Y [--via std] [--count 1] [--pitch 1.2,0]
  unvia NET X,Y | NET ...
  zone NET [--layers F.Cu,In1.Cu] [--outline X,Y ...] [--priority 1] [--clearance 0.25] [--min-width 0.15mm] [--min-island-area 2.0] [--pad-connection solid|relief|none] [--relief-gap 0.3mm] [--spoke-width 0.3mm] [--relief-tht-only]
  unzone NET ...
  pair NET+ NET- [--max-skew 1mm]
  text STRING [--layer F.SilkS] [--at X,Y] [--size 1.0] [--rotation 90] [--locked]
  fanout REF [--via bga] [--skip-rings 2] [--always GND] [--skip A1] [--nets GND,3V3] [--exclude C2?]
  stitch NET [--via std] [--pitch 2.5mm] [--fence RF_*] [--offset 0.5mm] [--margin 0.6mm] [--outline X,Y ...]
  watermark [--at X,Y] [--layer B.SilkS] [--rotation 90] [--hide]
  test [--nets 3V3,*RST*] [--exclude LED_*] [--side B] [--through-holes] [--no-vias] [--min-test-pad 1.0mm]
  board NAME
  schematic NAME

agentee edit board ITEM COMMAND [args]   (sch = sch:NAME, pcb = pcb:NAME)
agentee edit board -   commands on stdin, one per line
agentee edit board FILE   commands from a file; the project needs exactly one board for this

  class NAME [--track-width 0.2mm] [--clearance 0.2mm] [--via std] [--current 1A] [--max-temp-rise 10C] [--impedance 50ohm] [--impedance-tolerance 10%] [--solver field] [--diff-gap 0.15mm] [--coplanar-gap 0.2mm] [--layers F.Cu] [--max-skew 1mm] [--max-uncoupled 1mm] [--neckdown 1mm] [--width LAYER=WIDTH ...] [--description TEXT]
  unclass NAME ...
  via NAME [--drill 0.3mm] [--diameter 0.6mm] [--type through|blind|buried|microvia] [--from F.Cu] [--to B.Cu] [--fill filled_capped] [--drill-kind laser] [--stacked] [--skip] [--cost 2.0] [--backdrill-from L] [--backdrill-to L] [--backdrill-diameter 0.4mm]
  unvia NAME ...
